title: The Keys of the Unseen Are with Allah

paragraphs.text: Those who deny the verses will be punished. The Prophet does not claim to know the unseen. He is not an angel. He only follows what is revealed. Warn people with the Qur'an. Do not send away those who call their Lord every day.

Greet the believers with peace. Allah has written mercy upon Himself. He forgives anyone who repents and corrects himself. The Prophet will not follow their desires. The decision belongs only to Allah.
Allah has the keys of the unseen. He knows all on land and sea. Not a leaf falls without His knowledge. He takes your souls at night. He wakes you again by day. Then you will return to Him.
Who saves you in the dark on land and sea? Allah saves you from every trouble. Yet you still worship others with Him. He can send punishment from above or below.
